name: HEVC Compact Database
description: Compact 4K HEVC profiles for Radarr and Sonarr. Movies prefer the shared elite Blu-ray score (hallowed, BHDStudio, HONE and the rest of that list), then a smaller disc, then FLUX/Kitsune/CMRG, then a PSA micro, then BYNDR or NTb. Dolby Vision is +1000, HDR and HDR10+ are +500, and Dolby Digital + is +125, inside the class gap. 4K Blu-ray without HDR is rejected. TrueHD and DTS-HD are rejected for direct play. The cap is 200 MB/min, so a long movie is not penalized for a large file.
